effects.lua_implementation: Fusion procedure has the two exact filters; single-range EFFECT_CHANGE_CODE in MZONE uses official passcode 66889139.

official_references.card_name: Gaia the Magical Knight of Dragons
official_references.matched_structure: Near-exact official Gaia Fusion materials and field name change.

effects.printed_clause: If Special Summoned: target a Gaia in GY/banishment and add it; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed targeted trigger accepts GY or face-up banishment with Necrovalley and adds one under id HOPT.

effects.printed_clause: If you Fusion Summon using a Normal Monster: the summoned monster can gain 2600 ATK; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Field summon-success trigger inspects the summoned Fusion's material group for TYPE_NORMAL, targets one qualifying event monster, and grants permanent +2600 with separate HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Post-material trigger inspecting reason/material and applying a stat modification.

effects.printed_clause: Main-Phase Quick Effect: target a "Spiral" Normal Spell/Trap in GY listing "Gaia the Dragon Champion"; apply its activation effect; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Main-Phase Quick Effect targets an eligible Normal Spell/Trap, uses CheckActivateEffect to import target/category/property and execute its activation operation; separate HOPT.

coverage_override.reason: The Fusion materials and on-field name change are covered together as the card's procedure/static identity unit. The salvage, Normal-material ATK gain, and copied Spiral activation are the three activated effects, each with its HOPT.
